title: 30 May 2013: Paul McCartney live at BOK Center, Tulsa, Oklahoma
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the BOK Center in Tulsa, Oklahoma, USA, on 30 May 2013.

It was the tenth show of the Out There Tour, which lasted for 91 dates between May 2013 and October 2015, and the second of two consecutive nights in Tulsa.

During the show McCartney dedicated ‘I Saw Her Standing There’ to a girl who was celebrating her 17th birthday. The girl held up a sign to attract McCartney’s attention, received a shout-out during the show, and had a song performed for her in the first encore.

.@PaulMcCartney just gave a birthday shout out to a girl in the crowd named Charlotte. Happy 17th Charlotte! Your sign paid off!

— BOK Center (@BOKCenter) May 31, 2013

#nowplaying I Saw Her Standing There – dedicated to Charlotte, the bday girl in the crowd who turned 17 today! #HappyBirthday

— BOK Center (@BOKCenter) May 31, 2013

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).

McCartney had previously performed at the BOK Center on 17 August 2009 during the Summer Live ’09 Tour. He returned there on 22 October 2025 for the Got Back Tour.
